data.name: Summoners War
data.detailed_description:
Summoners War: Sky Arena

The legendary turn-based strategy RPG with immersive storytelling — loved by over 300 million Summoners worldwide!

Join the spectacular global war alongside over 1,000 Monsters and experience the ultimate strategic fantasy battle.

The more you fight and refine your perfect strategies, the more your Monsters will grow into cherished companions across the Sky Islands.

[Summoners War: Sky Arena]

Official Community:

▶ Game Features

◆ Stunning Action and Infinite Strategy

Experience dynamic battles in a truly different fantasy world!

Utilize 23 types of Rune Sets, each with unique effects,

and build your own strategy to claim victory.

◆ The True Essence of a Collectible RPG: Massive Monster Collection

Fire, Water, Wind, Light, and Dark!

Five attributes and over 1,000 Monsters, each with distinctive skills and styles.

Maximize each Monster’s individuality and craft the ultimate strategy for thrilling victories!

◆ Infinite Possibilities! Upgraded Monster Summoning and Growth

Obtain a guaranteed default 5-star Monster with Summon Mileage that accumulates as you summon.

Power up Monsters with Relics, the new equipment that grants immense strength.

Build the ultimate Monster that stands above the rest!

◆ A World of Endless Adventure and Battle

Village, battle, adventure, collection, growth, and crafting!

Uncover the schemes of dark forces and take down powerful bosses like Dragons and Giants.

Join real-time 3-player raids, awaken new power in the Dimension Hole,

explore Tartarus’ Labyrinth, hunt giant slimes with guildmates,

and engage in intense Guild PvP battles.

◆ Real-Time Global Strategy Battles

Real-time tactical duels that begin with Pick & Ban!

Engage others in Challenge Battle, where victory belongs to strategy with equally provided Monsters.

Compete in the World Arena, the pinnacle of strategic combat,

and prove your mastery on the global stage in the SWC (Summoners War World Championship)!

◆ Fast Growth Support System to Become a Stronger Summoner

Farm efficiently with Ameria's Luck and Scout Battle!

From support quests for new and returning Summoners to special tasks that guarantee a 5-star Monster!

Dive into the world of Summoners War at lightning speed!

data.short_description: A global hit RPG that captured the Summoners all around the world! Jump into the Sky Arena, a world under battle over the vital resource: Mana Crystals. Design your own deck and strategy using 1,000 Monsters to claim victory. Go on an epic adventure with your Monsters!
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Portuguese - Brazil

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 460 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Onboard Audio or higher
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Onboard Audio or higher
